prompt: Antique steel engraving of the open sea seen from above, a fine nautical chart illustration drawn entirely in engraved line work, filling the whole image edge to edge with water. The lower third of the image is calm open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines. Across the upper two thirds, one single chain of flat round white buoys joined one after another by one thin rope, crossing the sea in a straight diagonal: the chain begins with a first white buoy in the upper left area, well inside the image with open water between it and the left edge and the top edge, and runs down to the right through a few more white buoys to the last buoy in the lower right area, also well inside the image. The rope starts at the first buoy and ends at the last buoy; no rope goes beyond them, nothing touches or leaves the edges of the image, the whole chain is fully visible with water all around it. The white buoys are plain flat discs lying on the water, their faces blank. The last buoy is larger than the others and filled with cobalt blue #3D6FD9, and on its face it carries one bold off-white check mark, a tick: a short stroke going down to the right, joined at a sharp corner to a stroke twice as long going up to the right, both strokes equally thick, the corner near the bottom of the disc, a clear approval tick, upright and tidy, not a wide open V shape, not tilted, not a letter. Buoys and rope are drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved hatching on their rims, small ripples drawn as engraved lines around each buoy. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no photograph, no 3D, no glossy plastic, no cast shadows, no glow, no flag, no mast, no boat, no person, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border, no frame, full-bleed. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of cobalt blue #3D6FD9 on the last buoy only.
